summary: JPM filed Q1 10-Q on May 1 2026. Q1 profits rose 13% YoY. CEO Jamie Dimon warns of 'increasingly complex set of risks' including geopolitical tensions, energy volatility, and trade uncertainty. Dimon stepping down as CEO Jan 1, 2027; Marianne Lake to succeed him. Harassment lawsuit refiled against exec Lorna Hajdini (May 4). NII guidance lowered from $104.5B to ~$103B for 2026.
